A type of '''Reconnaissance Droid''' were large automatons built for combat and recon duties.

==Description==
These droids were large, bipedal droids colored red and black, armed with two pincers. They were used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Raygar]] during his quest for the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]]. Pieces of these droids were also used on the Ewok Belt of Honor.
